source_caption:
The Moment Succession Became Legendary.

Stuck in a brutal New York traffic jam, Kendall is forced to fight for the future of Waystar Royco through frantic, desperate phone calls. The tension builds to a crescendo, only for Kendall to walk into the boardroom and realize he didn’t just lose, he walked straight into a slaughterhouse.

Logan Roy doesn't just defeat the vote of no confidence; he obliterates it. In a matter of seconds, he asserts absolute dominance, fires the dissenters, and looks his own son in the eye to show him exactly how dangerous he can be. He is the chairman. He is the boss. And everyone else is entirely expendable.

I win.
.
.
.
